# MyApp Evaluation Harness

This project evaluates the quality of AI chat responses from the MyApp agentic application using [Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/ai/evaluation).

## Structure

- **EvaluationTests.cs** — Standalone evaluation tests that directly call the chat model and evaluate responses for relevance, coherence, and fluency.
- **IntegrationEvaluationTests.cs** — Integration tests that boot the Aspire app host and evaluate responses end-to-end (tagged `Integration`).

## Configuration

Set the following environment variables before running:

### Chat model under test
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `CHAT_MODEL_ENDPOINT` | Azure OpenAI endpoint for the model under test |
| `CHAT_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT` | Deployment name (default: `gpt-4o`) |
| `CHAT_MODEL_KEY` | API key |

### Evaluator model (judges response quality)
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `EVALUATION_MODEL_ENDPOINT` | Azure OpenAI endpoint for the evaluator |
| `EVALUATION_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT` | Deployment name (default: `gpt-4o`) |
| `EVALUATION_MODEL_KEY` | API key |

## Running

```bash
# Run standalone evaluation tests
dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~EvaluationTests"

# Run integration tests (requires Azure resources)
dotnet test --filter "TestCategory=Integration"

# Run all
dotnet test
```

## Results

Evaluation results are written to disk under the test output directory (`eval-results/` and `eval-results-integration/`). Use the reporting tools to generate HTML reports from these results.

# MyApp Evaluation Harness

This project evaluates the quality of AI chat responses from the MyApp agentic application using [Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/ai/evaluation).

## Structure

- **EvaluationTests.cs** — Standalone evaluation tests that directly call the chat model and evaluate responses for relevance, coherence, and fluency.
- **IntegrationEvaluationTests.cs** — Integration tests that boot the Aspire app host and evaluate responses end-to-end (tagged `Integration`).

## Configuration

Set the following environment variables before running:

### Chat model under test
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `CHAT_MODEL_ENDPOINT` | Azure OpenAI endpoint for the model under test |
| `CHAT_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT` | Deployment name (default: `gpt-4o`) |
| `CHAT_MODEL_KEY` | API key |

### Evaluator model (judges response quality)
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `EVALUATION_MODEL_ENDPOINT` | Azure OpenAI endpoint for the evaluator |
| `EVALUATION_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT` | Deployment name (default: `gpt-4o`) |
| `EVALUATION_MODEL_KEY` | API key |

## Running

```bash
# Run standalone evaluation tests
dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~EvaluationTests"

# Run integration tests (requires Azure resources)
dotnet test --filter "TestCategory=Integration"

# Run all
dotnet test
```

## Results

Evaluation results are written to disk under the test output directory (`eval-results/` and `eval-results-integration/`). Use the reporting tools to generate HTML reports from these results.
